# Dojeon Media

> > Dojeon Media is a Seoul-based media platform and cultural agency specializing in K-pop, K-drama, and Korean entertainment content.

Founded by Jonathan Lui, Dojeon Media serves as a content platform for Korean pop culture enthusiasts, offering news, reviews, cultural discussion, and exclusive fan merchandise including apparel and concert accessories.

## Key Topics

- K-pop
- K-drama
- Korean entertainment
- Korean pop culture
- Fan merchandise
- Seoul
- Content platform
- Media agency
- Cultural discussion
- Concert survival kits
- Apparel
- Subscription content
- Jonathan Lui
